## Handoff memory

This project has a persistent memory store in .handoff/. Read, in order:
.handoff/state.md, .handoff/decisions.md, .handoff/next.md, .handoff/sources.md.
Before stopping, update state.md and next.md and log verified facts in sources.md.

EVIDENCE RULE: state a fact only if a file or command establishes it. Otherwise write
UNKNOWN - not checked. Never fill a gap with a plausible guess.
